life.desc: You jump, but only after scouting the landing, packing a plan B and reading the fine print. Bold moves, tidy math.
life.sting: You'd rather lose with a plan than win on luck, so some great gambles never happen.
life.heart: Bold and careful. I get to be both.
life.read: You're the one who takes the big leap with the landing already mapped.

h.desc: You're drawn to new ground and big goals, and you prepare for them thoroughly: you study the terrain, set up a fallback and follow a clear method.
h.read: You're the one who takes real risks, and plans each one thoroughly.
h.sting: You'd rather lose with a plan than win by luck, and some good chances slip by.
h.heart: I can be bold and careful at the same time.
h.seed: It reaches for the far edge of the island, one careful branch at a time.

life.define: Goes after big goals with a clear plan.
life.seed: It grows toward the waterfall on purpose, one planned branch at a time.

life.name: The Go-Getter
life.desc: You want something big and you'll trade certainty to get it. The route is negotiable. The mission isn't.
life.sting: You'd rather regret doing it. Sometimes the bill comes, and you pay it alone.
life.heart: Even if I lose, I get a great story.
life.read: You're the one who goes for it while everyone else is still talking about it.

h.desc: You pursue big goals and accept uncertainty along the way. You adapt the route whenever it helps, and you keep your eyes on where you're going.
h.read: You're the one who moves toward what you want before the path is clear.
h.sting: You'd rather regret trying than waiting. When it costs you, you carry it alone.
h.heart: Going after what I want is worth it, however it turns out.
h.seed: It grows fast and bold, already reaching for the next terrace.

life.define: Sees a goal and goes for it.
life.seed: It shoots up overnight and is already eyeing the next terrace.

life.name: The Explorer
life.desc: You love new places and new things, you're in no hurry to get anywhere, and you keep your own clear rules wherever you go.
life.sting: You've been lots of places, and nobody knows where you're going next. Sometimes, neither do you.
life.heart: Curiosity picks the places. My values come along.
life.read: You're the one who goes far and always knows where your lines are.

h.desc: You're curious about the new and unhurried about getting anywhere, and you carry clear personal limits with you wherever you go.
h.read: You're the one who explores freely and keeps your values close.
h.sting: You've been to many places, and you rarely say where you're headed next.
h.heart: I explore freely, and my values travel with me.
h.seed: It sends roots out gently to every corner, curious about all of it.

life.define: Tries new things, with good judgment.
life.seed: It sends roots to every corner, checking out the whole island first.

life.name: The Spontaneous One
life.desc: You follow your curiosity wherever it goes. Plans and timelines stay loose for you, and the moment usually decides.
life.sting: Your freedom is your best quality, and sometimes your easiest way out of a hard conversation.
life.heart: I travel light and say yes to what feels right.
life.read: You're the one who says yes to the moment, and it usually pays off.

h.desc: You let curiosity guide you. Plans and rules bend for you, and you trust the moment to show you what comes next.
h.read: You're the one who trusts curiosity and the moment to lead the way.
h.sting: Your freedom matters deeply, and sometimes it's an easy way around a hard talk.
h.heart: I travel light, and I live by what feels true to me.
h.seed: It comes up somewhere unexpected, and it turns out to be exactly the right place.

life.seed: It sprouts somewhere nobody planted it, and somehow it's the best spot.

believeMinus.heart: What people often miss about you is how fast your independence gives way. When someone you love needs you, you are already on your way.

believeMinus.fun: Your quiet superpower: gentle almost all the time, then one clear sentence exactly when it counts. People carry that sentence for years.
believeMinus.heart: Your gentleness has a spine. When something truly matters, you say it clearly, and people know they can lean on your word.

believePlus.fun: From the outside you look like a keeper of tradition. Up close, your own life runs on rules you wrote yourself.
believePlus.heart: From the outside, you look like someone who keeps tradition. Up close, the choices that shape your own life are entirely your own.

believeMinus.fun: Your secret rule: rewrite everything, except the handful of rituals that make a place feel like home. Those stay exactly as they are.
believeMinus.heart: There is a rule you live by without naming it. You reshape almost everything, but a few familiar rituals stay, because they make a place feel like home.

believePlus.fun: You check the exits, read the reviews, pack the spare charger. Then a real door opens, and you're the first one through it.
believePlus.heart: You prepare carefully and like to know where you stand. When a real opportunity opens, you step through it sooner than most people would guess.

believeMinus.fun: The secret behind every leap you take is a soft place to land. You chase the new thing and keep a way home, which is why you keep leaping.
believeMinus.heart: Your sense of adventure rests on something steady. You move toward the new while keeping solid ground behind you, and that is what lets you keep going.

believePlus.fun: Your version of winning has a secret clause: free time. You'll chase the goal hard, but your own hours are the part you never trade.
believePlus.heart: Your idea of success includes time that belongs only to you. You work toward your goals, and you protect those hours as part of the win.

believeMinus.fun: The calm is real, and so is the fire. It just waits for a goal that's actually yours, then shows up all at once.
believeMinus.heart: Your calm is real, and so is your drive. It waits for a goal that genuinely matters to you, and then it shows up in full.

believePlus.fun: You're the one who keeps things fair, and also the one who quietly makes the exception when someone you love needs it. Both come from the same place.
believePlus.heart: You care about fairness, and you can see when a person needs an exception. For you, both come from the same place.

believeMinus.fun: Underneath all that go-with-the-flow is a firm line. When fairness is really on the table, you want it done properly, for everyone.
believeMinus.heart: Beneath your flexibility is a firm sense of fairness. When it truly matters, you want the same clear rules to apply to everyone.

We·Soft·Own.fun: People tell you things they haven't told anyone else. Something about you makes the truth feel safe to say.
We·Soft·Own.heart: People tell you things they have not said anywhere else. Something in the way you listen makes honesty feel safe.

We·Soft·Classic.fun: You're the one who remembers the coffee order, the pet's name, the hard anniversary. That's why your place feels like home.
We·Soft·Classic.heart: You remember the small details about people. That quiet attention is much of why they feel at home with you.

We·Direct·Own.fun: Nobody has to decode you. People always know where they stand, and that's exactly why they relax around you.
We·Direct·Own.heart: No one has to guess with you. People know where they stand, and that lets them settle.

We·Direct·Classic.fun: When the plan falls apart, heads turn toward you. By then you usually have the next step lined up.
We·Direct·Classic.heart: When things get hard, people look toward you. More often than not, you already know the next step.

Me·Direct·Own.fun: You don't need a crowd to know who you are. People trust you for exactly that reason.
Me·Direct·Own.heart: You know who you are without anyone confirming it. People find that steadying to be around.

Me·Direct·Classic.fun: Your word is the rare kind that holds. Say you'll be there, and people stop worrying, because you will be.
Me·Direct·Classic.heart: Your word holds. When you say you will be there, people stop worrying and plan around it.

Me·Soft·Own.fun: Your quiet superpower: you give people room to be exactly themselves, because you know what that room is worth.
Me·Soft·Own.heart: You give people room to be themselves. You know how much that room is worth, because you need it too.

Me·Soft·Classic.fun: Your calm is contagious. People leave time with you feeling lighter and can't quite say why.
Me·Soft·Classic.heart: Your calm settles the people around you, often without them noticing where it came from.

Steady·Push·Rules.fun: You finish what you start. It sounds simple, and it's the reason people quietly build their plans around you.
Steady·Push·Rules.heart: You finish what you start. People rely on that more than they say.

Steady·Push·Context.fun: Plans change and you just reroute. The goal stays in sight the whole time, even when the path doesn't.
Steady·Push·Context.heart: When plans change, you adjust without losing your direction. The path moves and the goal stays.

Steady·Easy·Rules.fun: Your routines are a home base other people borrow when their week goes sideways, more often than you'd guess.
Steady·Easy·Rules.heart: Your steady rhythm gives others something to lean on when their days feel unsettled.

Steady·Easy·Context.fun: You make a rough day feel smaller just by walking into the room.
Steady·Easy·Context.heart: Your ease makes hard days feel more manageable for the people near you.

Venture·Push·Rules.fun: Big ideas look doable around you, because you've already sketched steps one, two and three.
Venture·Push·Rules.heart: Ambitious ideas start to feel possible around you, because you can already see the steps.

Venture·Push·Context.fun: Things start happening once you're in. Your momentum is the push other people were waiting for.
Venture·Push·Context.heart: Your momentum helps other people begin. Things tend to move once you are part of them.

Venture·Easy·Rules.fun: You can land anywhere and still be completely yourself by the first morning.
Venture·Easy·Rules.heart: Wherever you go, you stay recognizably yourself, and that makes new places feel a little less new for the people with you.

Venture·Easy·Context.fun: You notice the detour everyone else walked past, and it usually turns out to be the best part.
Venture·Easy·Context.heart: You notice the possibilities other people pass by, and they are often the best part of the way.

tagRules.pairs: Every tag has exactly one opposite (pair). Support for a tag counts against its pair. The pair is the decoy card in friend game Level 3.

Circumstance, Not my life, No recent example and Skip never count. Up to 5 shown: strong tags first by net support, then the rest by coverage share (net support over what the player’s answered cards could give), from at least 3 chapters where possible.

'(slight)' means strength 1. The strings describe the evidence; the scored values live on the card options in chapters/*.final.json, and the strings are synced from the cards after card edits.

tagRules.dropped: Q03 (a woman publicly choosing traditional roles) and Q07 (sex before commitment) feed no tag. Q02 is removed from T15 and rebuilt as an everyday rule card in T25.

Frames carry no claim about the player by themselves; every claim on the page is a library line picked by the player's evidence. Placeholders in braces are filled with archetype names, stat names, stat ends and room names only. crossover: the strongest decided end of each people stat crossed with each life stat (key 'R?+|L?-', plus is the first pole of the stat), typed team or clash; the article shows the strongest team cell and the strongest clash cell. L3+.heart: You know how things are supposed to go, so the plan is safest in your hands.

L2-.fun: You're in no rush. You'll spend months on the plan, and it'll be flawless.
L2-.heart: You take your time and get it right, and every plan needs that patience.

L2+.fun: You go fast and you don't hesitate. That's exactly what the crew needs at the exit.
L2+.heart: You move quickly when it counts, and everyone trusts you to get them out.

L1+.fun: You're a regular everywhere. Same order for years, so nobody blinks when you walk in.
L1+.heart: You're steady and familiar, a face any place welcomes back without a second thought.

L3-.fun: You read the room and know which rule can bend. Every door has a side door, and you know where it is.
L3-.heart: You see what a moment needs and adapt to it, so you can be anywhere and fit right in.

L1-.fun: You'll try anything once, including a loud scene in a very fancy lobby.
L1-.heart: You're up for anything new, and that spark is impossible to look away from.

title.heart: Your green flag and your red flag

intro.fun: One of each. The red one's the cute kind.
intro.heart: One of each, and the red one is the sort people end up loving.

intro.fun: Genii's money is on you. Three bets, and Genii hates losing.
intro.heart: Genii's money is on you. Three gentle bets about the life you're living.

intro.fun: If Genii planted your answers on the island, this is what would come up.
intro.heart: If Genii planted your answers on the island, this is what would grow.

hook.fun: There, Genii's island grows from small moments of your real day. Snap one and watch.
hook.heart: There, Genii's island grows a little with each small moment of your real day.

R1+|L1+.fun: Same people, same places, for years. You're the reason the group still has a standing Thursday.
R1+|L1+.heart: You keep your people and your places close. Friendships that last for years usually have someone like you holding them.

R1+|L1-.fun: You want new places and your people in them. You're the one who turns someday into a booked trip.
R1+|L1-.heart: New places mean the most to you when your people come along. You're often the one who makes the someday trip happen.

R1+|L2+.fun: You want everyone at the table, and you also want the win. Some weeks the group chat loses to the goal, and you feel it.
R1+|L2+.heart: You want your people close, and you want to get somewhere. Some weeks one of them has to wait, and you feel it either way.

R1+|L2-.fun: You want everyone there and nobody stressed. Your plans stay loose on purpose, so anyone can tag along.
R1+|L2-.heart: You love having people around and you keep things easy, so time with you never feels like work.

R1+|L3+.fun: You want everyone in and everything fair. When a friend bends the rules, you're stuck between loyalty and keeping score.
R1+|L3+.heart: You want everyone included and everything fair. When someone you love bends the rules, both of those pull at you.

R1+|L3-.fun: You watch the group, not the plan. If someone's gone quiet, the night quietly changes around them.
R1+|L3-.heart: You notice how everyone is doing, and you'll change the plan so the quiet one feels included.

R1-|L1+.fun: Your own space, your own routine, your own corner of the world. Your ideal weekend is a nest, and you guard it.
R1-|L1+.heart: You need your own space and a steady place to come back to. Home is where you recharge, and you protect it.

R1-|L1-.fun: You'd happily take the trip alone. A new city, no group vote, nobody asking where to eat.
R1-|L1-.heart: You're happy exploring on your own. New places feel freest when you don't have to plan around anyone.

R1-|L2+.fun: Alone time is where the work gets done. Your best progress happens with the phone face down and the door shut.
R1-|L2+.heart: Your time alone is where you do your best work. Quiet and focus take you further than a crowd ever does.

R1-|L2-.fun: You like your space and you like it easy. The catch: a quiet week can turn into a quiet month before you notice.
R1-|L2-.heart: You need space and you like life gentle. Sometimes the quiet stretches longer than you meant, and the people who love you start to miss you.

R1-|L3+.fun: You run your life on your own rules, and you keep them. Nobody has to check on you, which is exactly how you like it.
R1-|L3+.heart: You set your own standards and you keep them. People trust you to handle things without being asked.

R1-|L3-.fun: You read the room perfectly, then leave it early. People feel seen by you, turn around, and you're gone.
R1-|L3-.heart: You notice how people feel, and then you slip away to recharge. They feel understood by you, and a little left behind.

R2+|L1+.fun: You say what you think and you stick with what works. People always know where they stand with you, and where to find you.
R2+|L1+.heart: You're honest and you're steady. People know where they stand with you, and they know you'll still be there.

R2+|L1-.fun: You'll say the plan is boring out loud, then pitch a wilder one. Great for the trip, rough on whoever made the first plan.
R2+|L1-.heart: You speak up when something feels stale, and you reach for something new. It opens doors, and sometimes bruises whoever planned the old way.

R2+|L2+.fun: You want the win and you'll say exactly what's in the way. It gets things moving, and it leaves a few people blinking.
R2+|L2+.heart: You aim high and you name what's blocking you. Things move, and sometimes people need a moment to catch up with how direct you were.

R2+|L2-.fun: You say it straight, then let it go. No grudges, no drama, no three-day sulk.
R2+|L2-.heart: You say what you mean, and then you let it rest. People love that nothing lingers with you.

R2+|L3+.fun: You call it when someone breaks the rules. You're right, and you're also why the group chat went quiet.
R2+|L3+.heart: When something isn't fair, you say so. You're usually right, and sometimes the room goes quiet after.

R2+|L3-.fun: You're honest, but you pick your moment. The truth from you lands because you waited until it could.
R2+|L3-.heart: You tell the truth, and you choose when. People can hear hard things from you because you read the moment first.

R2-|L1+.fun: Soft and steady, you're the friend people call when everything else is moving. Your kitchen is where hard weeks go to calm down.
R2-|L1+.heart: You're gentle and steady. When life gets loud, people come to you because being near you feels safe.

R2-|L1-.fun: You'd love to go, and you'd hate to upset anyone by leaving. Half your adventures are waiting on someone else's feelings.
R2-|L1-.heart: You long for new places, and you worry about who you'd leave behind. Sometimes your adventures wait until everyone else is okay.

R2-|L2+.fun: You're soft on everyone's feelings and hard on your own goals. Everyone gets your patience except you.
R2-|L2+.heart: You're gentle with everyone else and demanding with yourself. The kindness you give so easily is the kindness you're slowest to give you.

R2-|L2-.fun: Easy on people, easy on life. Time with you feels like a Sunday, and people keep finding reasons to stay.
R2-|L2-.heart: You're gentle with people and easy with life. Time with you feels unhurried, and people tend to stay longer than they planned.

R2-|L3+.fun: You believe in the rules, and you'd rather not be the one enforcing them. So you drop hints and hope someone else says it.
R2-|L3+.heart: You care about doing things fairly, and you'd rather not confront anyone about it. So you hope, quietly, that someone else will.

R2-|L3-.fun: You read the room and you say things kindly. People walk out of hard conversations with you feeling better than they walked in.
R2-|L3-.heart: You notice what people need and you speak with care. Hard conversations with you tend to end softer than they started.

R3+|L1+.fun: Same traditions, same table, same recipe every year. You keep how things are done, and people count on it.
R3+|L1+.heart: You love traditions and a steady home. The rituals you keep are how the people around you feel held.

R3+|L1-.fun: You love doing things properly, and you love new places. So you travel with rituals: the same first coffee, a new city every time.
R3+|L1-.heart: You love the classic way of doing things, and you love somewhere new. So you carry your rituals with you, wherever you go.

R3+|L2+.fun: You respect the ladder and you climb it fast. Titles, milestones, the proper way up: you want every rung.
R3+|L2+.heart: You believe in the proper path, and you work hard on it. The milestones matter to you, and you earn each one.

R3+|L2-.fun: You want things done the proper way, just not this week. The thank-you card is perfect, and three weeks late.
R3+|L2-.heart: You care about doing things properly, and you like an unhurried pace. The thoughtful gesture always comes, sometimes a little after the moment.

R3+|L3+.fun: Traditions and rules, both taken seriously. When a friend wants to do it differently, you fight the urge to hand them the manual.
R3+|L3+.heart: You honor how things are done, and you keep things fair. When someone you love wants a different way, letting them can take real effort.

R3+|L3-.fun: You know the proper way to do everything, and exactly when to skip it. Your traditions bend so people don't have to.
R3+|L3-.heart: You know the traditional way, and you can tell when it would hurt someone. You'll bend a custom so a person doesn't have to.

R3-|L1+.fun: You make your own rules and live them close to home. Invented holidays, house rules, a routine nobody else would pick.
R3-|L1+.heart: You build your own way of living, close to home. Your routines and rituals are yours, made up and kept with love.

R3-|L1-.fun: No script and no map. You'd rather get lost somewhere new than follow anyone's itinerary, and you have the stories to prove it.
R3-|L1-.heart: You follow your own path, and you love the unknown. The best parts of your life came from roads nobody told you to take.

R3-|L2+.fun: You want to win, just not the way anyone told you to. You'd rather build your own ladder than climb theirs.
R3-|L2+.heart: You're driven, and you want to get there your own way. You'd rather make a new path than follow the expected one.

R3-|L2-.fun: You live on your own terms and you take it easy. Freeing, right up until someone asks about your five-year plan.
R3-|L2-.heart: You live your own way and at your own pace. It feels free, and it can unsettle people who want to know what's next.

R3-|L3+.fun: You make your own rules and follow them to the letter. Other people's rules, though? Those are suggestions.
R3-|L3+.heart: You write your own rules and keep them faithfully. Rules someone else wrote feel more like suggestions to you.

R3-|L3-.fun: You don't follow scripts, and you can tell when a rule is hurting someone. Put together, you're the one who rewrites the plan so it works for everyone in it.
R3-|L3-.heart: You make your own way, and you notice when a rule is hurting someone. Together, that makes you the one who quietly rewrites the plan so it fits the people in it.
